pages.text: A cultivator's true flame. Hold the skill key to breathe fire, burn targets in front of you, and refine smeltable blocks or items.

$(bold)Type:$() Intrinsic Skill$(br)$(bold)Input:$() Hold the skill key$(br)$(bold)Cost:$() 400 magicules per second, or 200 per second with a Heaven Spirit Root$(br2)While the breath remains on a target, each damage check has 10 base damage. Fire Spirit Root increases damage by 50%, while Heaven Spirit Root increases it by 60%. Releasing the key removes the Alchemist Fire breath entity.
